notes.experiment: Establish Primary->UOP leakage baseline, then exclude exactly one current SecID secondary asset at a time.
notes.comparison: When baseline and exclusion both return FLOW_FOUND, compare fresh-session SPV search effort. If exclusion returns clean NO_FLOW_PROVEN, treat that as a stronger status transition rather than merely a runtime increase.
notes.runtime_guardrail: Proof/runtime differences are formal solver/search evidence, not direct security severity or path length.
notes.cex_guardrail: Jasper CEX cycles are observed witness lengths, not guaranteed globally shortest paths.
notes.fresh_sessions: Each effort repeat uses a new work directory. Odd/even repeats reverse condition order to reduce a simple order/time confound.
notes.reuse_patch: Updated from 11 to 10 retained assets. Reuse baseline and indices 0-8 from the completed v1.3.0 campaign; run only index 9 (dbg_0.dbg_uart_0.xfer_buf_nxt) when prior parsed results are present.
